head: 73c4b4a6c4fb97e5e92d97b450c15f58ff1c0a30
detail: Selected Render Surface from the v5 dependency-ordered queue after confirming Render Device is proven.
The candidate has correct broad ownership but generic schemas, aggregate-only factories, incomplete atomic manifests, weak snapshot semantics, and an unjustified Resource dependency.
Replaced the generic candidate with one base Surface owner, eight bounded leaf Kits, strict semantic references, and provider-neutral exact-once registries.
Closed ownership collisions, raw mutation bypasses, orphan references, semantic contradictions, ABA revisions, incomplete receipt coverage, forged receipt results, and mutable snapshot identity.
Both final read-only reviews reported no remaining P0/P1 source-level blockers under the source-first policy.
Render Surface source is ready to commit; behavioral, package, consumer, and matrix proof remains deferred until source freeze.
